title: Fidget spinner spin-down
headline: Rubbing friction c = 0.9000 ± 0.0014 rad/s²
blurb: Wonder guessed exponential decay. The held-out frames said otherwise.

title: Pendulum at 50°
headline: g = 9.80 ± 0.10 m/s²
blurb: A big swing breaks the textbook formula. Then the ghost predicts a second trial.

title: Steel ball drop
headline: g = 9.75 ± 0.15 m/s²
blurb: A 1.2 m drop at 240 fps. The simplest law wins, and says why it can't say more.

title: Pendulum that wandered off the wall
headline: Can't tell yet: out-of-plane motion
blurb: The bob drifts toward the camera. Ghostline says it can't tell, and what to change.
